1. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flange member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, wherein the composite fabric layer is __woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein the adhesive is __a structural adhesive sheet wrapped around the filler__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, and __the fabric layer comprises woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein __the layer of adhesive comprises a folded sheet of structural adhesive that is distinct from any adhesive contained within the laminated composite tape plies__.

4. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, and __the composite fabric layer is woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__.

6. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, and __the offset is created by wrinkles in the laminated composite tape plies__.

7. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, wherein the composite fabric layer comprises __woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, wherein the adhesive is __a structural adhesive sheet wrapped around the filler__.

8. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein each of the composite channels and the base includes laminated composite tape plies with __unidirectional reinforcing fibers__.

9. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes __woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__.

10. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 9, wherein the bidirectional reinforcing fibers are __graphite__.

11. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, __or__ a titanium member.

12. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes __three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, wherein each patch comprises woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler.

14. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges, and __the adhesive is a structural adhesive distinct from any adhesive contained within the laminated composite tape plies__.

15. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __C-shaped in cross-section and the base is flat-plate-shaped__.

16. (Original) A method of fabricating a composite stiffener, comprising: forming a pair of composite channels each having a flange and a radius portion, using composite fiber tape; placing a layer of composite fiber fabric over the radius portion of each of the channels; forming a base using composite fiber tape; placing a reinforcing filler in at least a portion of the base; placing a layer of adhesive around a filler; positioning the filler in the radius filler zone between the radius portions of the channels and the base; and, curing the assembly.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the forming of the composite channels includes laying up unidirectional reinforcing fibers.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein placing the adhesive comprises wrapping the filler with a sheet of adhesive.

19. (Original) The method of claim 16, further comprising: placing a layer of composite fiber fabric on sections of each of the channels, the base and the cap outside the radius filler zone; and, introducing a layer of adhesive between the layers of composite fiber fabric on the sections outside the radius filler zone.

20. (Original) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener, comprising: forming a composite structure having a web and a pair of flanges extending in opposite directions from the web, using laminated composite tape plies in an area between the web and the flanges; joining a surface of the cap to the flanges; applying a layer of composite fabric to the surface of the cap joined to the flanges; placing a reinforcing filler between the web, the flanges and the cap; and, using an adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers on the composite structure and the cap.

21. (Original) The method of claim 20, wherein: forming the composite structure includes forming the laminated tape plies into first and second channels, and applying a layer of composite fabric over the laminated composite tape plies includes placing patches of the composite fabric on selected areas of the first and second channels.

22. (Original) The method of claim 21, further comprising: placing a layer of composite fabric on facing surfaces of each of the first and second channels; introducing an adhesive between the layers of composite fabric on the facing surfaces of the first and second channels; and, joining the first and second channels together at the facing surfaces.

23. (Original) The method of claim 20, wherein using an adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers includes wrapping a layer of structural adhesive around the filler.

24. (Original) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: forming multi-ply lay-ups of unidirectional composite tape; forming the lay-ups into first and second C-channels, a cap and a base; assembling the C-channels, the cap and the base into an I-section structure having a web and a pair of flanges on each end of the web; applying composite fabric to surfaces of the C-channels, the cap and the base in areas forming radius filler zones at the intersection of the web with the cap and with the base; wrapping a reinforcing filler with a structural adhesive; placing the reinforcing filler and the adhesive in the radius filler zone; and curing the assembly.

25. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape with a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a pair of composite channels, each including radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap and base, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels, cap and base, wherein the composite fabric layer comprises __woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of structural adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, wherein the adhesive is __distinct from any adhesive contained within the laminated composite tape plies__.
